 Lynchburg Reminds Voters: Election Day Is Tuesday, November 3 
 News Flash
 Lynchburg Reminds Voters: Election Day Is Tuesday, November 3
 Communications & Public Engagement
 Posted on October 30, 2026 
 The City of Lynchburg Office of the General Registrar reminds all eligible voters that Election Day is Tuesday, November 3, 2026 . Polling places throughout the city will be open from 6:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. 
 Voters are encouraged to plan to vote, confirm their polling location, and review ballot information before heading to the polls.  
 The Office of the General Registrar is committed to supporting elections conducted with transparency, integrity, accuracy, and fairness . Public confidence in elections is strengthened through clear communication, established procedures, and a commitment to ensuring every eligible voter has the opportunity to cast a ballot.
 Every eligible voter is encouraged to participate, become informed about the voting process, and know that our office is dedicated to conducting elections in accordance with Virginia law.
 Voters who have questions about their registration status, polling location, identification requirements, or other election-related matters are encouraged to contact the Office of the General Registrar.
 Election Day Information 
 Date: Tuesday, November 3, 2026
 Polling Hours: 6:00 a.m. – 7:00 p.m.
 The Office of the General Registrar encourages all eligible Lynchburg residents to make their voices heard and reminds the community that public trust, transparency, and integrity remain central to the administration of elections.
